name: Package feedback
about: Rate setup, share friction, or suggest an improvement for any ATP package
title: '[Feedback] '
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

## Package and environment

- Package name and installed version
- Node.js version and operating system
- Package manager and version
- Agent runtime and version, if relevant
- For legacy OpenClaw migration, include the target package and version

## Setup rating

Choose 1 (could not get it working), 2 (difficult), 3 (manageable), 4 (easy), or 5 (very easy). You can leave this blank if you only want to report a blocker.

## What you tried

What were you trying to build or run? Which quickstart or guide did you follow?

## What worked and where you got stuck

Describe the first point of friction and what would improve it. Include expected and actual results where relevant.

## Related bug or question

Link an existing bug or Q&A thread, if there is one. A reproducible bug can be filed with the Bug Report template and linked here.

Before posting, remove credentials, private keys, personal data, and private audit material. For vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md and use a private reporting channel.
